questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The best presents to give at Christmas
What it takes to be a good Santa
How Christmas is celebrated around the world
Why children stop believing in Santa
questions.why: Neil says the topic is 'What makes the perfect Santa?'

questions.q: When Dan says Christmas is all about presents, what does he really mean?
options: He loves receiving expensive gifts
He thinks Christmas has become too commercial
He enjoys giving presents to others
He prefers presents to food
questions.why: Dan explains he was talking about giving presents, not getting them.

options: A man who runs a school for Santas in London
A famous actor who plays Santa on TV
A children's writer
A shop owner who hires Santas
questions.why: Neil says he runs a Santa school at his company Ministry of Fun in London.

questions.q: According to James Lovell, what is a key part of being Father Christmas?
options: Having a real white beard
Knowing every child's name
Giving the best presents
Doing a perfect 'ho ho ho!'
questions.why: He says 'a perfect ho ho ho! is a key part of being a Father Christmas'.

questions.q: How does James Lovell do his 'ho ho ho'?
options: He shouts it as loudly as possible
He sings it with a group of children
He says it quietly and slowly
He taps his tummy and smiles widely
questions.why: He says he likes to 'reach down into my tummy, tap it and with a big smile' say it.

questions.q: What does Dan think might be hard about the job?
options: Wearing the heavy costume all day long
The pressure of impressing lots of children
Working very long hours in the busy shop
Remembering the names of all the reindeer
questions.why: Dan thinks there would be 'a lot of pressure to perform' with all the children to impress.

questions.q: Which of these does James Lovell NOT say a Santa needs?
options: A deep singing voice
Magical eyes
Lots to say
To look good
questions.why: He lists looking good, lots to say, being very jolly and magical eyes, but not a singing voice.

questions.q: How does Dan feel about becoming a Santa by the end?
options: He is ready to start next week
He wants to open his own Santa school
He is having second thoughts about it
He thinks it would be very easy
questions.why: Dan says he's having second thoughts and it might be 'a challenge too far'.
